name: User feedback
job: What people say about your product and your rivals, filed under the feature it is about
intro: User feedback finds the sentences about your product in each member's mail and meetings, and in public posts about you and your rivals, and files each one under a feature. Keep, move or set aside each quote with one key; a kept request is told where it was asked when the feature ships.
does: Sentences from your own mail and meetings stay yours until you share them; only the sentence and who said it reach the team.
Every feature with its quotes by company and the deal behind each, and what rivals' users say about the same thing.
This week: what's rising against the usual, a suggested feature from quotes that fit none, and likely duplicates to merge.

accounts.why: Each member's own mail, through Mail: read for what customers say, kept private until they share.
Optional: YouTube, X, Reddit, TikTok and LinkedIn through your own key. Hacker News is free.

setup: Once for the whole Lemma: your product, its features (paste a list, or let the Lemma propose them), rivals, public listening and who files.
Each person chooses whether their mail and meetings are read, and whether what customers say is shared on its own.
Or look around with a sample: a made-up product, two made-up rivals and eight weeks of what people said.
